content: Leaflet stable is 1.9.4 (released 2023-05-18); 2.0.0-alpha.1 exists (Aug 2025) but is alpha. Sizes v1.9.4: leaflet.js ~145-147KB uncompressed / ~42KB gzipped; leaflet.css ~14.8KB uncompressed (~4KB gzipped). Self-hosting also nominally needs the images/ marker-icon PNGs referenced by CSS, but a track map can use L.circleMarker + L.polyline (pure vector, no image assets). Official download page: leafletjs.com/download.html; dist via unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/.
